posts.body_html:
TBH, this thing doesn't really stand out in terms of shape or overall appearance, but it does raise eyebrows (mainly Ellie and Benny's eyebrows) when it comes to how white the lid is! Long story short, I'm going to keep an eye out on this one and see if it becomes something really interesting as it matures.

We've had a lot of cool weather this year, which is why the lids have some red spots on them, otherwise they'd be perfectly pristine white! Pics taken 6/22/23:


You can see Ellie's Sibling to the right to compare whiteness! In defense of Ellie's Sibling, those were recently divided:






Might be more interesting once it produces a solid red throat:
